lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: have you been well?

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Although my days have passed without much incident,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: it recently feels as if a chokehold has been placed upon my heart,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: and my life has become a torpid mélange of melancholy exasperations.
What is it that's bothering you?

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: My master is someone who plays a wide variety of musical compositions originating from the surface,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: but just as there is no being in this world who can resist the flow of the wind and the waves,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: so it has come to pass that my master has been engulfed by the vicissitudes of time,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: rendering him incapable of creating new melodies.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: As you are well aware, melodies from the surface are as hard to find as the sun in the night sky.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: That is why I,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: this humble disciple,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: am hoping I can gift my master a rejuvenating melody.
It seems Julia wants to play some new music for the music master.
Should I try and find sheet music, or a music file?

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: I'm only reading your words on a digital screen,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: and yet my heart is about to leap out of my chest.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Either of those will do just fine.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: I will claim that music for my own

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: and share it with the master.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: I want to put some wind back in my master's sails.
I'm not sure whether this will pan out, but I'll try.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Many thanks!

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Oh, how my heart is racing!

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: I must calm myself with some serene melodies, ones that resemble calming precipitation.
